title: OSCORE spec gap: C firmware has no production path satisfying spec 15.3 OSCORE state persistence
description:
SPEC: spec/06-security.md §15.3 (lines 1219-1238, landed 2026-08-28 in 660b9bf3bf): sender sequence reservations, recipient replay window, and response replay/correlation state MUST remain valid across restart; state MUST be persisted in a versioned authenticated record bound to the context under an independent monotonic rollback-and-deletion authority; missing/corrupt/unavailable state MUST fail closed. Implements RFC 8613 §7.5.

IMPL (two halves, both verified):
1. The compliant path exists and is correct: CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_SETTINGS (lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/Kconfig:36, default y) requires a platform-protected authority via oscore_settings_register_protection() (oscore_settings.c:166) before any context creation; restore/commit are bound to a BLAKE2b digest over IDs/algo/keys/IV (oscore_settings.c:108-139) with A/B slots + revision+digest authority (oscore_persist.c:309-386, fail-closed on deleted/torn/rolled-back state). BUT no caller registers the authority anywhere in the repo (grep for oscore_settings_register_protection outside tests: zero hits). With the default (SETTINGS=y, e.g. lichen/apps/puck/boards/t1000_e_nrf52840.conf:100-101), oscore_ctx_create* fails OSCORE_ERR_NVM_FAILED (oscore_ctx.c:355-368) — fail-closed and safe, but OSCORE is unusable in every default production C build.
2. With CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_SETTINGS=n (or SETTINGS=n), contexts CAN be created with no persistence at all: only the sender SSN has an app-supplied NVM hook (oscore_nvm_register_callbacks — registered only by tests); the recipient replay window and response correlation state are RAM-only. Contexts are static across reboots (coap_keys_oscore.c:56 derives the master secret deterministically from the peer public key via oscore_ctx_create_from_peer_key), so after restart the device accepts previously-received requests — a direct spec §15.3 / RFC 8613 §7.5 violation (nonce-safety of the sender side is preserved by the set_sender_seq gate, but the replay window is not).

OBSERVED: no production-viable C configuration satisfies §15.3 today: settings-on fails closed at context creation (feature dead), settings-off loses replay protection across restart.

FIX: register a platform-protected monotonic authority (e.g., NVS-backed counter namespace separate from the blob slots) during native/board init before first OSCORE context creation, and wire it in puck/gateway C init; alternatively gate context creation on persistence being ready in ALL configs (remove the unprotected fallback) so the unprotected path cannot be built. Related: project-LICHEN-r6fu.2 (stale: 'OSCORE not implemented in C firmware'), project-LICHEN-ow3c.1.4 (tests for NVM failure paths).
